blocks.text: Ice Fishing In Detroit Lakes, MN

Ice Castle Sleeper Rentals • Day Houses • Guided Trips

​

​Experience the best ice fishing in Detroit Lakes with Baxstar Fishing — the only ice fishing service in the region owned and operated by an award-winning professional fishing guide. Whether you're booking a luxury Ice Castle sleeper, a heated day house, or a fully guided trip, we make sure you’re on fish and fully taken care of from start to finish.


 


Detroit Lake offers incredible multi-species action just minutes from restaurants, bars, stores, and hotels — giving you the perfect blend of outdoor adventure and in-town convenience.
